evidence.testName: renaming a barrel exported name preserves the origin and updates every public consumer

assertions: Cross-module barrel rename updates every public consumer without changing origin identity.

evidence.testName: renaming an explicit barrel alias changes only the public alias layer

assertions: Renaming an explicit barrel alias does not rename the origin declaration.

evidence.testName: prepareRename returns the source alias range and placeholder after an emoji

assertions: Prepare rename returns the exact UTF-16 source alias range after a non-BMP character.

evidence.testName: rejects rename when the target name already exists in the same scope

assertions: Rename fails atomically when the new name conflicts in the same scope.
